meta.title: Eval cycle 14 lock-ins (engine2/eval/cycles/14/triage.md): power needs fit, substrate checks

principles.P-POWER-FIT: A strong card is a suggestion only when it does something for THIS deck — power without a plan link, a goal fill or a gap in its own job is just a good Magic card
principles.P-SUBSTRATE: A card whose text needs something (colored commander identity, lifegain, three artifacts, X/1 bodies, tapped lands, creature counters) isn't suggested where that something is missing

assertions.note: colorless commander: 'any color in your commander's identity' makes nothing; no lifegain
damage sweepers kill Zada's own token board
extra upkeeps multiply upkeep costs; few tapped lands
doubles one creature's counters, not loyalty
